records.title: DynoDINO: Harnessing Dynamic Latent Information from DINO Features for Multi-Phase Medical Image Segmentation
records.reason: The primary paper applies attention/memory techniques to CECT lesion segmentation and measures segmentation quality, not LLM generation or serving.

records.title: CACHE-UK: A Stability-Aware Memory Editor for Sequentially Updated Quantized LLMs in Finance
records.reason: The primary paper reports sequential-edit stability on a 4-bit OpenLLaMA, but its 28% generalization success and lack of inference-cost measurements make its relevance to quantized serving uncertain.

records.title: CoGate: Confidence-Gated Co-Decoding for Secure Code Generation
records.reason: The paper improves secure-code metrics through expert co-decoding but reports no serving speedup; the added expert’s decode cost is unmeasured.

records.title: CyberNeuro: A Privacy-Preserving Agentic Workbench for Cohort-Scale Neuroimage and Clinical Data Analysis
records.reason: The paper’s token reduction is an aggregate agent-workflow/provider comparison without isolated model/runtime controls, so it does not establish a general inference optimization.

records.title: From Single Chatbots to Governed Agent Ecosystems: An Agentic AI Pattern Catalogue and Orchestration Framework for Mission-Critical Hospital Information Management Systems
records.reason: The abstract mentions vLLM and optimized paging in a hospital orchestration framework, but full text is unavailable to verify implementation or serving measurements.
